usage.callShape: GET https://api.cn402.com/hanzi/s2t?text=<urlencoded simplified chinese> (x402 paid, ~$0.0022 USDC on Base). NOTE: registry says POST but POST 404s; real method is GET with text as query param.
usage.outputShape: body.output (converted traditional Chinese string); body.input (echo of input); body.mode = "simplified->traditional"
quirks: Registry/probe say method=POST, but POST returns 404 'Cannot POST /hanzi/s2t' with NO payment taken. The endpoint is GET-only.
Input text is passed as a URL query param ?text=<urlencoded>, NOT as a JSON body.
402 challenge advertises maxAmountRequired 2200 (=$0.0022 USDC) on Base, asset USDC 0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913.
Result is in body.output. Some characters (e.g. 你好世界) are identical in Simplified and Traditional so output may equal input; body.mode confirms the conversion direction was applied.
usage.guide: Call GET https://api.cn402.com/hanzi/s2t?text=<URL-encoded Simplified Chinese text> with x402 payment (~$0.0022 USDC on Base, no API key). Do NOT use POST — POST 404s. Read the converted Traditional Chinese from body.output; body.mode confirms it ran simplified->traditional. Note that ASCII-shared or script-invariant characters may come back unchanged.
